name: TRM Status
description: Instant status table across all TRM research topics in trm-vault: source/extract counts, staging backlog, extract lag, staleness, uncommitted files, and concrete next steps per TRM.
author: Soren (Cast Iron Forge)

inputs.vaultRoot: string (optional) — trm-vault root directory, defaults to C:\Users\soren\trm-vault

outputs.statusTable: tab-separated table: TRM name, state (STUB/STAGING PENDING/EXTRACT LAG/STALE/ACTIVE), source/extract counts, next steps

tooltip: One-shot status table across all TRM research topics: counts, backlog, staleness, next steps.
